paragraphs.zh: 将27.4g  2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99.7％、0.0788mol)，0.2g  DMF(99％、0.0027mol)，12.3g氯化亚砜(99％、0.102mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将9.5g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.084mol)、100ml二氯乙烷加入反应瓶，在25～30℃滴加18.5g三乙胺(99％、0.18mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入1g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.011mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加甲醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得30.3g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.6％，收率86％。
paragraphs.en: 27.4 g of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid (99.7%, 0.0788 mol), 0.2 g of DMF (99%, 0.0027 mol), 12.3 g of thionyl chloride (99%, 0.102 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane are charged into a 250 ml reaction flask; the temperature is raised and the mixture is reacted at reflux, and after the reaction is finished the solvent is stripped off completely. 9.5 g of 1,3-cyclohexanedione (99%, 0.084 mol) and 100 ml of dichloroethane are charged into the reaction flask, and 18.5 g of triethylamine (99%, 0.18 mol) is added dropwise at 25 to 30 degrees C; the reaction is followed by LC until complete. After the reaction is complete, 1 g of acetone cyanohydrin (95%, 0.011 mol) is added and the reaction is followed by LC until complete; after the reaction is complete water is added and the mixture is washed with water, the layers are separated, the oil layer is stripped free of solvent, methanol is added for recrystallisation, and the material is filtered and oven dried to give 30.3 g of beige crystalline powder, purity 98.6%, yield 86%.
paragraphs.notes: Every figure re-read off the image at high magnification and confirmed against the text layer: 27.4g / 99.7％ / 0.0788mol; 0.2g DMF 99％ 0.0027mol; 12.3g 氯化亚砜 99％ 0.102mol; 100ml and 250ml; 9.5g 1,3-环己二酮 99％ 0.084mol; a second 100ml; 25～30℃; 18.5g 三乙胺 99％ 0.18mol; 1g 丙酮氰醇 95％ 0.011mol; 30.3g product, 纯度98.6％, 收率86％. 二氯乙烷 is printed with NO locant in both places it occurs; it reads literally as 'dichloroethane' and the 1,2-isomer has NOT been inferred into the transcription or the translation. 丙酮氰醇 verified character by character as acetone cyanohydrin; it is NOT 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone). It is added after the diketone acylation, i.e. as the cyanide catalyst for the enol-ester to triketone rearrangement, but the paragraph never names that intermediate or calls the reagent a catalyst, and no intermediate is drawn. ARITHMETIC SANITY CHECK, run only as a check and never used to supply or alter a digit: 27.4g x 0.997 / 346.7 = 0.0788 mol; 12.3 x 0.99 / 118.97 = 0.102; 0.2 x 0.99 / 73.09 = 0.0027; 9.5 x 0.99 / 112.13 = 0.084; 18.5 x 0.99 / 101.19 = 0.18; 1 x 0.95 / 85.10 = 0.011; and 30.3g x 0.986 / (0.0788 x 440.8) = 86%. Every printed figure is internally consistent, which corroborates the transcription.
Example 1 ends at [0046]. Everything from here to the foot of the page belongs to Example 2.

paragraphs.zh: 本实施例提供一种环磺酮的合成工艺，包括以下步骤：
paragraphs.en: This example provides a process for the synthesis of tembotrione, comprising the following steps:
paragraphs.notes: Ends with the full-width colon '：' as printed.

paragraphs.zh: 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成
paragraphs.notes: Step heading for Example 2 step 1. The name in the heading matches the structure drawn below at [0050] substituent for substituent, including the 甲酯 (methyl ester) which the drawing shows as H3CO-.
Marker printed at the left margin with no text of its own; the slot for the drawing of the Example 2 step 1 product. See drawings[1].

paragraphs.zh: 将40g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.7％、0.152mol)，200ml二氯甲烷，0.5g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.003mol)，34g氢溴酸(48％、0.202mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在45～50℃滴加25g双氧水(30％、0.22mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，乙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得46g白色粉末，纯度99.8％，收率88.5％。
paragraphs.en: 40 g of methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (99.7%, 0.152 mol), 200 ml of dichloromethane, 0.5 g of azobisisobutyronitrile (99%, 0.003 mol) and 34 g of hydrobromic acid (48%, 0.202 mol) are charged into a 500 ml reaction flask, and 25 g of hydrogen peroxide (30%, 0.22 mol) is added dropwise at 45 to 50 degrees C; after the addition is complete the reaction is continued and followed by LC until complete. After the reaction is complete the layers are separated, the organic layer is washed with water and concentrated, recrystallised from ethanol, filtered and oven dried to give 46 g of white powder, purity 99.8%, yield 88.5%.
paragraphs.notes: Every figure re-read off the image at high magnification and confirmed against the text layer: 40g / 99.7％ / 0.152mol; 200ml 二氯甲烷; 0.5g 偶氮二异丁腈 99％ 0.003mol; 34g 氢溴酸 48％ 0.202mol; 500ml; 45～50℃; 25g 双氧水 30％ 0.22mol; 46g product, 纯度99.8％, 收率88.5％. The '40g' was double checked at full resolution because a first low-magnification pass misread it; the printed value is 40g. 偶氮二异丁腈 = AIBN, the radical initiator. The brominating system is 氢溴酸 (hydrobromic acid) plus 双氧水 (hydrogen peroxide, i.e. HBr/H2O2 generating bromine in situ); no elemental bromine and no NBS is named. ARITHMETIC SANITY CHECK, run only as a check and never used to supply a digit: 40 x 0.997 / 262.71 = 0.152 mol; 0.5 x 0.99 / 164.21 = 0.003; 34 x 0.48 / 80.91 = 0.202; 25 x 0.30 / 34.01 = 0.22; and 46 x 0.998 / (0.152 x 341.6) = 88.5%. All internally consistent.

paragraphs.zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成

structures.core: Two rings joined by a bridging carbonyl. Left: cyclohexane-1,3-dione drawn in the KETO tautomer, a plain hexagon of single bonds carrying two exocyclic C=O and no ring C=C and no OH. Right: a benzene ring, tetrasubstituted, drawn with three internal double bonds. The bridge is a carbon bearing an exocyclic =O, single bonded to the diketone C2 on one side and to the benzene ipso carbon on the other.

CH2OCH2CF3 at C3, drawn as the atom-label string CH2OCH2CF3
SO2CH3 at C4, drawn out as a central S with two =O and a CH3
benzene ring: C5 and C6 unsubstituted CH
structures.name: 2-{2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione)

drawings.notes: Single product structure, no arrow and no reagents drawn. It illustrates the heading at [0044], '3、环磺酮的合成', and is therefore the INVENTION'S OWN route, specifically the final product of step 3 of Example 1, not prior art. Nothing on this page is prior art: both Example 1 and Example 2 are worked examples of the invention. Ring numbering is stated relative to the drawn attachment point: the benzene carbon bearing the bridging carbonyl is called C1 and the ring is walked clockwise from it, which is the order the substituents appear in the drawing. The adjacency actually read off the drawing, and the only claim being made, is: the Cl carbon is adjacent to the attachment carbon; the CH2OCH2CF3 carbon is adjacent to the Cl carbon; the SO2CH3 carbon is adjacent to the CH2OCH2CF3 carbon; the remaining two ring carbons are unsubstituted. The drawing is clean vector line art at full resolution with no broken or ambiguous bonds. Note that the diketone is drawn as the keto tautomer with a CH at C2, not as the enol that 2-aroyl-1,3-diones commonly adopt; recorded as drawn.

Re-read at high magnification the page prints 27.4g, (2,2,2-三氟乙氧基) and (99.7％ with no internal spaces, and the same tokens are emitted unspaced elsewhere in the same file (line 21 gives '99.7％' cleanly), so the spaces are an extraction artifact of CNIPA's fixed-width digit cells. discrepancies.what: Reagents written but not drawn. All three drawings on this page are lone product structures; none of the reagents named in the prose appears in any drawing, and no arrow is drawn anywhere on the page.
discrepancies.drawing_says: drawings[0] shows only tembotrione; drawings[1] shows only the bromomethyl methyl ester; drawings[2] shows only the trifluoroethoxymethyl benzoic acid. No arrows, no reagents above or below anything, no starting material shown for any step.
discrepancies.text_says: [0046] names 氯化亚砜 (thionyl chloride), DMF, 1,3-环己二酮, 三乙胺 and 丙酮氰醇, and [0051] names 偶氮二异丁腈, 氢溴酸 and 双氧水. None of these is drawn. This is the patent's convention of captioning each numbered step with its product alone, not damage or an omission, but a downstream pass must not read these drawings as schemes: the transformations exist only in the prose.

discrepancies.what: Intermediate described in neither prose nor drawing. The [0046] sequence implies an enol ester that is never named and never drawn.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a, drawings[0] shows the final product only
discrepancies.text_says: [0046] goes from the acid plus 氯化亚砜 straight to adding 1,3-环己二酮 and 三乙胺, then adds 丙酮氰醇, then works up to the product. The acid chloride and the enol ester that acetone cyanohydrin rearranges are implied by the reagent order but are named nowhere and drawn nowhere. They have NOT been inferred into any field.

discrepancies.what: A solvent is named without its locant.
discrepancies.drawing_says: n/a, no drawing on this page names a solvent
discrepancies.text_says: [0046] says only 二氯乙烷 (dichloroethane), twice, never 1,2-二氯乙烷. The 1,2-isomer is the usual reading but the isomer is not stated on the page and has not been supplied in the transcription or the translation.

discrepancies.what: Punctuation width in the image is not a reliable guide on this page and downstream passes must take the text layer's widths, not the picture's.
discrepancies.text_says: CNIPA's fixed-width setting renders half-width '(' ')' as visually wide glyphs and compresses the full-width '，' toward a Western comma, so the two cannot be told apart by eye on the rendered page. Per the born-digital rule the text layer is authoritative for characters: parentheses on this page are half-width, prose commas are full-width '，', enumeration marks are '、', and the percent signs, tilde ranges and '℃' are full-width. The header uses the ideographic space U+3000 between 说 明 书.
